title: ResponseSubscription
description: A subscription with its assignment counts.

adamId.description: The Adam ID for the subscription.

counts.description: The assignment counts for the subscription, broken down by renewal state.

parentAdamId.description: The parent Adam ID for the subscription. This value can be `null`, so don’t require it when you parse a subscription record.

periodEndDate.description: The end date of the current billing period in ISO-8601 calendar date format (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

status.description: The current state of the subscription.
